meta.title: Moments · Photographs and films from the Gurukul
meta.description: Photographs and short films from the Gurukul: the dawn recitation, lessons, the midday meal, lamps at dusk. New moments are added through the year.

hero.h1: Photographs and films from the Gurukul.
hero.lede: A festival, an examination, the monsoon, a new student's first morning. New pictures and short films are added here through the year, so that people far away can see what their gift keeps alive.

more: More moments will appear here as the year unfolds.
